goal: Decouple low-level socket I/O from Bitcoin P2P logic to make networking modular and reusable
Speed up internal peer lookups from linear to constant time
reviewability: Author has been silent for 196 days
agreement: Supported for modularity and tested against prototype network services (pinheadmz, ryanofsky, Sjors)
Blocking objection: wrong abstraction level and ill-suited for general use outside P2P (theuni)
Blocking objection: returning raw node pointer after unlocking mutex risks dangling pointer (hodlinator)
Nonblocking objection: maintaining separate maps to link IDs and metadata is fragile (ryanofsky)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it addresses a major structural burden by separating socket polling from P2P logic
It decouples networking for future protocol improvements and speeds up peer lookups
